earnings.title: 3M Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results; Raises Full-Year EPS Guidance
highlights: Q3 GAAP sales of $6.6 billion, up 1.0%; operating margin of 23.7%, up 150 bps; EPS of $2.63, up 70%, all YoY
Adjusted EPS of $2.50 on new basis 1 , up 12% YoY
Adjusted sales of $6.6 billion with organic growth of 3.3% YoY
Adjusted operating margin of 26.2% on new basis 1 , up 110 bps YoY

quotes.text: We delivered another quarter of strong results, including solid sales growth, continued margin expansion, double-digit EPS growth, and robust free cash flow.

outlook: 2026 adjusted EPS guidance raised to $9.10 to $9.15, incorporating new basis

items.heading: * The Company’s results are impacted by the effects of, and changes in, worldwide economic, political, regulatory, international trade, geopolitical, tariffs and retaliatory counter measures, and other external conditions.
items.group: Risks Related to the Global Economy and External Conditions

items.heading: * Foreign currency exchange rates and fluctuations in those rates may affect the Company’s ability to realize projected growth rates in its sales and earnings.
items.group: Risks Related to the Global Economy and External Conditions

items.heading: * The Company faces liabilities related to certain fluorochemicals, which could have a material adverse effect on our results.
items.group: Risks Related to Legal and Regulatory Proceedings

items.heading: * The Company’s results are affected by competitive conditions and customer preferences.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Products and Customer Preferences

items.heading: * The Company’s growth objectives are largely dependent on the timing and market acceptance of its new product offerings, including its ability to continually renew its pipeline of new products and to bring those products to market.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Products and Customer Preferences

items.heading: *The Company’s use of artificial intelligence technologies exposes the Company to risks which could have a material adverse effect on the Company’s business, reputation and results of operations.
